source_of_truth.report_identity_rule: Report Key R#### equals the original Excel row number in the no-fields catalog.

synthetic_relevance.null: pooled candidate with no synthetic judgment

important_limitations: Synthetic labels are weak supervision and are not human ground truth.
Dense embedding and cross-encoder feature columns are null and marked unavailable until model inference populates them.
Fields are linked through Phase2_Field_Dictionary.xlsx Where_Used values; duplicate report titles are explicitly flagged as ambiguous.

files.annotation/candidate_pool.csv: Blended candidate pool derived from the no-fields catalog and field dictionary.
files.processed/ranking_features.parquet: One row per query-candidate pair with baseline ranking features.
files.processed/answerability_features.parquet: One row per query with answerability features.
